title: Retarget an embedded template-engine host
goal: Move a template-engine host off the removed netstandard route, select a verified net10 or net11 dependency closure and preserve the framework of generated applications.

selectionNotes: Prefer ordinary net10 when appropriate; net10 and net11 hosts have independently restored, built and executed the actual RC2 dependency closure.
Target-10 selection requires deliberately adopting the newer template packages; the exact eight .NET 10 foundations are unchanged.

runtime.name: .NET
runtime.reason: Actual host runtime, separate from the generated net10 application. Measured runtime10 is 10.0.13; runtime11 is RC2.

sdk.name: .NET SDK
sdk.reason: Build the host target; exact evidence uses SDK10 10.0.402 or SDK11 11.0.100-rc.2.26504.105.

language.name: C#
language.reason: Declared sample mode; no C#15-only capability is required.

frameworks: Standalone Microsoft.NET.Sdk managed host; historical library uses netstandard2.0.

packages.name: Microsoft.TemplateEngine.Edge
packages.reason: Actual inspected, restored and executed RC2 artifact, not an SDK-root assembly.

packages.name: Microsoft.TemplateEngine.Orchestrator.RunnableProjects
packages.reason: Actual generator component set used to instantiate the original embedded template.

packageAssets: TemplateEngine 11.0.100-rc.2.26504.105 lib/net11.0 selected independently for this route; NuGet 8.0.0-rc.605 uses lib/net10.0.
Historical 10.0.402 netstandard library selects lib/netstandard2.0; its actual net10 runner selects lib/net10.0. Full locks and evidence record every transitive package and hash.
providers: Built-in folder template provider, virtualized settings and trusted embedded seed; no remote provider or account.
platforms: Windows x64 execution; other operating systems/architectures and .NET Framework were not executed.
prerequisites: SDK/runtime10 and SDK/runtime11 for paired reproduction; PowerShell7 and public network for package acquisition.
Current NuGet.* 8.0.0-rc.605 dependencies require the public dotnet-tools feed and explicit source mapping; the old set instead uses nuget.org.
Keep package versions/SDKs pinned, use locked restores, isolated homes/caches and DOTNET_ADD_GLOBAL_TOOLS_TO_PATH=0.
constraints: Host TFM and generated-application TFM are separate; all three real hosts create and execute a net10 application.
All eight removed netstandard routes are independently probed. Default implicit Framework fallback gives NU1701; strict current restore fails NU1202. Suppression is not compatibility.
RC2 ZIPs and selected assets establish net10 rather than the note's net9 recommendation. No net9 or Framework route is advertised.
No IDE/localization behavior, general untrusted templates, post-action execution, trimming or Native AOT claim.
stabilityLimitations: Prerelease RC2 package/SDK proof, not GA reconciliation; no experimental API switch. NuGet client APIs do not promise general API stability.
PIN-959 qualifying coverage/evidence and PIN-963 actual-GA reconciliation remain open.

sources.title: Pinned Edge project: actual host and NuGet dependency boundary

evidence.scope: Actual historical netstandard host compilation plus sixteen audited ZIPs, eight old direct builds/eight strict RC2 NU1202 restores and default NU1701 fallback control.
Actual netstandard library consumed by a net10 runner, template instantiation, generated net10 application compiled/executed; runner assets independently select net10.
Real ordinary net10 host restores/builds/runs RC2 packages with the actual closure; instantiated net10 application also builds/runs with SDK/runtime10.
Independent actual net11 host and RC2 closure instantiate the same net10 template; generated application builds/runs with SDK/runtime10.

humanProof.scope: Bounded managed Windows x64 host/template consumers execute automatically; no provider/device/Human-only or public-publication requirement.
